name: Strigid Owl Feather
summary: Strigid Owl Feathers are gathered from the owls in Teldrassil's boughs. Zenn Foulhoof seeks them for his covert dealings.

sections.title: Forest Plumage and Dark Dealings
sections.body: Strigid owls and screechers hunt through the Crown of the Earth. Their feathers and down lie across the forest floor. Outside Dolanaar, the renegade satyr Zenn Foulhoof sends inexperienced travelers down the road from Shadowglen to gather strigid feathers, spider silk, and nightsaber fangs for his shady business.

faq.q: Where can I find Strigid Owl Feathers?
aliases: where do strigid owl feathers drop
faq.answer: Strigid owls and strigid screechers live in the woodlands around Dolanaar and across Teldrassil, where you can gather their feathers.
Zenn Foulhoof, a satyr along the trail into Dolanaar, asks you to gather the feathers with webwood silk and nightsaber fangs.

faq.q: What does Zenn Foulhoof use the feathers for?
faq.answer: Zenn says the feathers are reagents for his secret business in the forest. He also takes pleasure in tricking unsuspecting recruits into doing his dirty work.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Teldrassil's owls are creatures of Elune. Zenn Foulhoof's exploitation of them insults the sacred wood.
As a druid, you hold Teldrassil's avian hunters in high regard. Seeing their feathers gathered under false pretenses for suspicious reagents can unsettle you.
